projects.title: Selected
projects.description: Some of the projects I've developed and participated in.

darrow.subtitle: Multi-service Telegram Web App — Taxi, Food Delivery & Handyman Services
darrow.description: Co-developed a Yandex Go-style super-app running inside Telegram's in-app browser. Part of a 3-person remote team (1 backend, 2 frontend). Built booking and ordering flows across 4 service categories, optimized UI for Telegram's constrained WebView, and integrated REST APIs for real-time order processing.
highlights: Architected booking flows for taxi, food delivery, handyman services, and shop orders — all sharing a unified UI component library
Optimized for Telegram WebView limitations: implemented JS-based viewport height calculations where CSS dvh units failed
Integrated REST APIs handling 5,000+ total orders with centralized error handling and loading states

smart_life.subtitle: Full-scale E-Commerce Platform — Live at smartlife.uz
smart_life.description: Built the complete customer-facing storefront for Smart Life, an electronics retailer in Uzbekistan. Solo frontend developer responsible for product catalog, cart system, and checkout — from Figma to production deployment on Next.js.
highlights: Built product catalog with URL-based filtering (shareable/bookmarkable filter states) and debounced search to minimize API calls
Implemented cart and order management with RTK Query — optimistic updates for instant-feeling UI, automatic cache invalidation on mutations
Mobile-first responsive design serving 70%+ mobile users — every component designed at 320px first, then enhanced for desktop

dna_technology.subtitle: Corporate Website & Medical Equipment Catalog
dna_technology.description: Built a full corporate website and product catalog for a high-tech medical laboratory equipment distributor in Uzbekistan, serving B2B clients (doctors and lab technicians). Architected a frontend that presents complex scientific and medical data in a clear, accessible way.
highlights: Download hub for technical specs (.ini) and drivers — users can quickly locate hardware config files via search filters and download them without interruption
Multi-level medical catalog for hundreds of complex PCR kits and lab equipment (DTprime, DTlite) with a nested dynamic filtering and category sorting system
Optimized pages for heavy medical documents with SSR — pages open in seconds for both search engines (SEO) and end users

tola_bot.subtitle: Recurring Payment Reminder
tola_bot.description: Built a Telegram Web App that prevents missed monthly utility payment deadlines in Uzbekistan. Responsible for a fast 1-second-load UI, automated reminders, and database integration.
highlights: Smart reminders & subscriber codes — user enters data once; the system sends a reminder 2 days before and on the morning of the payment due date
Zero-cost server architecture — the full backend and database run on free cloud infrastructure (Vercel + Supabase) at no expense
No-install design — users need no separate app download; the UI is optimized for instant loading inside Telegram's in-app browser

auto_quiz.subtitle: Automated Test Generation Platform for Teachers — Web App
auto_quiz.description: Built a modern automated system for teachers to create professional tests in minutes — replacing Excel and Word. Designed the full UI/UX and frontend architecture of the platform.
highlights: Auto A4 layout algorithm — distributes questions across pages, perfectly placing 10 questions in 2 columns per A4 sheet
Export & print system — ready test materials can be downloaded as high-quality PDF and PNG files with intact design and fonts
Multi-page SPA routing — fast client-side routing manages templates, test creation panel, and user's personal test archive without reloads

vocab_app.subtitle: Vocabulary Memorization & Review App for Language Learners — Personal Mobile App
vocab_app.description: Developed a React Native mobile application for language learners to systematically learn, store, and regularly review new words. The app features categorized word entry, daily review scheduling, and randomized recall tests to assess knowledge.
highlights: Batch word entry — users can quickly and conveniently add multiple new words at the same time
Daily review system — reinforces vocabulary through scheduled spaced repetition of learned words
Randomized recall tests — words are presented in random order to effectively test the user's retention rate
